verdict.rationale: Working Copy exposes automation via the Shortcuts app and a conversational 'Repository Agent' that can browse, search, read/modify files, commit, pull and push, giving some non-UI access to core git actions, but there is no documented REST/OpenAPI surface (probe shows no openapi.json, llms.txt, or machine-readable docs) proving full UI-parity for an AI-native/API consumer. missing for 10: a formal API/SDK spec covering all UI actions, evidence that Shortcuts actions cover every UI feature (branches, tags, submodules, resolve tool, etc.), and independent confirmation of Repository Agent's coverage.
